email.subject: AI for Berlandi Nussbaum & Reitzas LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Sarah,

I noticed Berlandi Nussbaum & Reitzas handles Congressional and Governmental Investigations alongside Banking & Structured Finance work. That mix demands precision and deep expertise, exactly what smaller teams need to compete.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
